description.la: Libri V De consideratione ad Eugenium papam tertium.
description.en-US: Bernard’s five books for his former monk Pope Eugene III: the need to set time for reflection amid the cares of office, the self-knowledge and knowledge of what is below, around, above and within the pope, and the contemplation of God. The Latin is the Maurist text in Migne (Patrologia Latina 182, 1854). Latin only, from the Maurist text in Migne, a machine-corrected OCR.
description.pt-BR: Os cinco livros de Bernardo ao papa Eugênio III, seu antigo monge: a necessidade de reservar tempo para a reflexão entre os cuidados do ofício, o conhecimento de si e do que está abaixo, ao redor, acima e dentro do papa, e a contemplação de Deus.

la.editor: Jean Mabillon, in J.-P. Migne (Patrologia Latina 182)

sources.edition: S. Bernardi Claraevallensis abbatis opera omnia, ed. J. Mabillon, in Migne, Patrologia Latina 182 (Paris 1854); TEI XML of the Corpus Corporum (University of Zurich), work 21483, from machine-corrected OCR.
sources.description: The complete text with Mabillon’s admonitio, chapter headings and summaries. PL page breaks and column numbers are dropped, and so are the paragraph numbers; Scripture references stay in parentheses as printed.
sources.tierEvidence: Bernard died in 1153; Migne’s printing is public domain everywhere.
